work_item: - Curriculum management: `LessonProposalService` (propose/approve/reject/resubmit) and the Teacher/Approver UI. **Note (checker finding, commit c318bc5 review):** `EntraCurrentUserContext` resolves the caller via `IHttpContextAccessor`, which is null outside the initial HTTP request in Blazor Server's interactive (SignalR circuit) render mode — fails closed (safe, not a security hole) but will functionally deny authorised users once this UI goes interactive. Fix by surfacing the authenticated user via `AuthenticationStateProvider`/persisted state instead, as part of this item.
1. Progress tracking: `CompletionService`, `PromotionService` (auto-promotion), `CertificateService` (QuestPDF PDF generation to Blob Storage).

- **EF Core provider migration: Azure SQL Database → self-hosted PostgreSQL (Npgsql).** Foundational — everything else in this pivot builds on it. Switch `VlmsDbContext`'s configured provider from `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer` to `Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL`; regenerate migrations for PostgreSQL syntax. Port the ADR-0004 §4 tamper-protection DDL from `DENY UPDATE, DELETE ON dbo.SensitiveDataAccessLogs TO public` to `REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE ON sensitive_data_access_log FROM PUBLIC` (naming convention: confirm/apply this repo's chosen PostgreSQL identifier casing convention before writing it) — same structural guarantee, ported not redesigned (`docs/adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md`). Update `tests/Vlms.Tests/Infrastructure/MigrationsTests.cs`'s `IMigrator.GenerateScript()` assertions to match the new DDL. Decide and document the test-provider strategy: the existing SQLite-in-memory-via-DI pattern was always a test double (even pre-pivot) and EF Core's query-filter/interceptor behaviour is provider-independent, so it likely stays as the default for most tests — but confirm this explicitly rather than assuming, and keep the `GenerateScript()`-based (no live connection needed) pattern for the Postgres-specific DDL assertions. Update connection-string config keys/placeholders in `appsettings.json`/`appsettings.Development.json` away from SQL-Server-shaped values.

- **Identity: replace Microsoft Entra External ID with self-rolled ASP.NET Core Identity (built-in TOTP MFA), and replace the Microsoft Graph guardian-invitation mechanism with a self-rolled emailed, signed, single-use invite link scoped to the correct `Student` record.** Read current Microsoft Learn ASP.NET Core Identity + Blazor Web App (Server interactivity) guidance before implementing — verify the current recommended integration shape rather than assuming (`CLAUDE.md` "verify, don't invent"). Design how `AppUser`/`UserRole` (this project's existing application-level role model, ADR-0002, unaffected in principle) coexist with ASP.NET Core Identity's own user store — document that decision explicitly, it's a real judgement call. Remove `EntraCurrentUserContext`, `UserProvisioningService`'s Entra-specific pieces, `Microsoft.Identity.Web`/OIDC wiring in `Program.cs`, and the placeholder `AzureAd` config section; replace with an Identity-based `ICurrentUserContext` implementation. This retires (not just unblocks) the former `## Blocked / needs decision` Entra-tenant item below — see the Log entry recording that retirement.
